bull.b: Strong revenue growth combined with net retention above 100% indicates Braze is expanding within its installed base while adding customers. This recurring expansion supports more durable growth than one-time bookings and can deepen customer dependence on the platform over the next several quarters.

Braze has shifted from negative free cash flow in earlier periods to meaningful positive generation, showing better operating efficiency and cash discipline. Sustained cash conversion gives the company greater capacity to fund product investment, sales expansion, and strategic initiatives internally.

bull.t: AI product adoption and platform expansion
bull.b: Broadening paid adoption of multiple AI products increases the platform's strategic value and creates additional expansion opportunities within large accounts. Integrated decisioning, personalization, and agent capabilities can strengthen differentiation and support higher customer engagement over time.

bear.b: Braze has improved its losses but has not yet converted strong revenue growth and gross profitability into positive GAAP operating or net earnings. Continued losses could constrain financial flexibility and leave the business dependent on further efficiency gains to demonstrate durable earnings power.

Premium messaging growth and added Decisioning Studio cost of revenue are reducing gross margin as the product mix evolves. If these costs scale with adoption, they could limit operating leverage and require pricing, infrastructure, or product-efficiency improvements to preserve long-term margins.

The prolonged transition from legacy pricing and packaging creates execution complexity across the customer base and complicates revenue comparisons. Reclassification of some subscription revenue as professional services may also obscure underlying trends while migration work continues through the next several quarters.
